About ITFB Community:
Interested Technology for Blind (ITFB) is a dedicated community working towards the digital empowerment and independence of visually impaired individuals. We focus on providing accessible technological solutions, step-by-step training, and resources to make everyday digital life easier and more self-reliant for screen reader users.

About DhwaniTTS:
DhwaniTTS is an open-source, fully offline text-to-speech engine powered by the Piper TTS architecture. It is specifically designed to be highly responsive and seamlessly accessible with TalkBack. With DhwaniTTS, users can enjoy natural-sounding, human-like voices in multiple global languages without relying on an active internet connection. Our ultimate goal is to provide a smooth, privacy-focused, and high-quality reading experience for everyone.
